fullName.value: Synaptic vesicle membrane protein VAT-1 homolog

texts.value: Multifunctional protein with enzymatic and transport activities (PubMed:17105775, PubMed:26394711, PubMed:32005660, PubMed:33483563). Probable NADPH-dependent quinone oxidoreductase which physiological substrates and function are unclear (PubMed:33483563). Alternatively, has also been suggested to mediate the transfer of negatively charged phospholipids including phosphatidic acid (PA), phosphatidylserine (PS) and phosphatidylglycerol (PG) between endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondrial membranes (PubMed:26394711, PubMed:32005660). Could regulate mitochondrial fusion through its interaction with mitofusins (PubMed:17105775)

reaction.name: 2 a quinone + NADPH + H(+) = 2 a 1,4-benzosemiquinone + NADP(+)

texts.value: kcat is 1.13 sec(-1) with 9,10-phenanthroquinone as substrate.
Forms homodimers and homotetramers (PubMed:32005660, PubMed:33483563). Interacts with MFN1 and MFN2; regulates mitochondrial membranes dynamic (PubMed:17105775)
The majority is localized in the cytoplasm and a small amount is associated with mitochondria
Expressed in brain. Also expressed in glioblastoma cells
Up-regulation in basal keratinocytes is Ca(2+)-dependent
Belongs to the zinc-containing alcohol dehydrogenase family. Quinone oxidoreductase subfamily
